title: M'Odo
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: M'Odo , the Gnarled Oracle , is a zombie elf wizard from an unknown plane. The character of M'Odo was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2017 Heroes of the Realm program. M'Odo appears to be a light-skinned elf with long ears, orange patterns tattooed across the body, performing magic in a giant skull.
